news.title: Search for second suspect after shooting injures 2 at Atlanta apartments
news.summary: Atlanta police are asking for the public's help to identify a second shooter after stray bullets pierced two southwest Atlanta apartments and struck two women inside earlier this week.

news.summary: College Park Police seized drugs, firearms and cash and arrested a driver during recent law enforcement operations.

news.summary: A Lithonia man was sentenced for shooting and killing a woman he was dating while on the phone with 911, according to the DeKalb County District Attorney's Office.

news.summary: A traffic stop in Cartersville led to a woman’s arrest for narcotics possession, all thanks to a new K9 on the job, the Cartersville Police Dept. said.

news.summary: The woman told police she encountered a man dressed as the Joker who offered to buy her a drink. After she declined, the man allegedly grabbed her by the arm.

news.summary: Lakewood Police are mourning the loss of Agent Nicholas Alan Graham, who died in a shooting that also injured four others, including three agents.

news.summary: The family of two teenagers gunned down in Lawrenceville is remembering the two brothers who were shot and killed on Wednesday during a vape sale turned wrong.

news.summary: Traffic is flowing again along the Downtown Connector after earlier police activity shut down Interstate 75/85 at North Avenue for roughly two hours Friday night.
